chapter.heading: Job 12
Job Replies: The LORD Has Done This
chapter.v: Then Job answered and said :
and wisdom will die with you .
Who does not knowsuch things as these ?
a just and blameless man , am a laughingstock .
it is ready for those whose feet slip .
who bring their god in their hand .
the birds of the heavens , and they will tell you ;
and the fish of the sea will declare to you .
thatthe hand of the Lord has done this ?
and the breath of all mankind .
as the palate tastes food ?
and understanding in length of days .
he has counsel and understanding .
if heshuts a man in , none can open .
if hesends them out , they overwhelm the land .
the deceived and the deceiver are his .
andjudges he makes fools .
and binds a waistcloth on their hips .
and overthrows the mighty .
and takes away the discernment of the elders .
and loosens the belt of the strong .
and bringsdeep darkness to light .
he enlarges nations , andleads them away .
andmakes them wander in a trackless waste .
and he makes themstagger like a drunken man .
